author: Alie Mansour
textEn: I had All Star Cleaning Services come by to do my home windows and they did a really solid job. Everything came out clean, clear, and streak-free. They were easy to work with, showed up on time, and were professional the whole time. I’ve also referred them to a few clients of mine who run businesses, and they’ve used them for commercial cleaning with feedback. Good, reliable service for both residential and commercial. I will definitely use them again.
textFr: J'ai fait appel à All Star Cleaning Services pour nettoyer les fenêtres de ma maison et ils ont fait du très bon travail. Tout est ressorti propre, clair et sans traces. Ils ont été faciles à côtoyer, sont arrivés à l'heure et très professionnels. Je les ai référés à plusieurs clients et le retour est excellent. Un service fiable tant résidentiel que commercial.
